title: 第一卷 第19章 红色的许青禾第一卷 第20章 副作用这么大
lines: 一只
两只
三只
足足有六只狼妖。
它们的体型比刚才那只更大。
为首的那只狼妖身高几乎快有两个普通人那么高了。
浑身灰黑色的毛发，嘴边还沾着血迹。
一双眼睛死死盯着秦烈和许青禾。
看到地上那只狼妖的尸体之后，他眼里的凶光就更重了。
秦烈下意识地用望气术看了一眼。
目标：狼妖】
妖气：小妖巅峰】
看到这个提示之后，秦烈的心立马沉到了谷底。
小妖巅峰！
这东西可不好对付了，说不定今天许青禾和他都得交代在这了。
昨天陆晨给他讲过妖族和人族的大致境界。
普通妖兽沾染了妖气，最多只能算个妖兽，大概也就比普通的野兽凶一点。
只有开了灵智，能说人话，懂得伪装和算计的，才能算小妖。
小妖境初期大概对应人族九品，中期就对应八品，后期差不多就可以对应人族七品。
至于小妖境巅峰，那就是快要摸到妖兵门槛的境界了。
换成人族里面，也差不多是七品里最难缠的那一批。
秦烈现在只有九品初期，就算他体质和敏捷比一般的九品强，但也不代表他能跟小妖境巅峰硬碰硬。
不过还好在还有许青禾在，看她现在这么镇定的样子，估计是能应付现在的场面的。
“镇妖司的小崽子们来得倒快呀。”
“敢杀我狼风的手下，你们的胆子不小呀。”
说话的时候，狼风露出了嘴里的森森白牙。
不过很快，他的目光就落在了许青禾身上，上下打量一番之后，嘴角扯出一抹恶心的笑。
“把这个男的杀了，女的留下，正好带回洞里给本大爷快活快活。”
秦烈听了这话之后，眼神瞬间冷了下来。
他握紧了手中的镇妖刀，刚想上前一步，可旁边的许青禾却轻轻笑了一声。
那笑声很轻，但是却让秦烈莫名地有点后背发凉。
许青禾慢慢合上自己手里的册子，抬头看向那只狼妖。
“你刚刚说什么？我没听清。”
“要不你再说一遍我听听。”
狼风听了之后，笑得就更嚣张了。
“老子再说一遍又能怎么样？”
“一会老子就要让你知道知道什么叫真正的快活！”
听到狼风说这话，秦烈默默地往后退了两步。
狼风没有注意到秦烈的动作，但是许青禾注意到了。
她转头看了秦烈一眼。
“你为什么后退呀？”
秦烈握紧了自己手中的镇妖刀，神色认真。
“我怕你待会动手的时候误伤到我了。”

There are six wolf demons in total.
They are larger than the one just now.
The leading wolf demon was almost as tall as two ordinary people.
He was covered in gray and black hair, and there was blood on his mouth.
A pair of eyes stared at Qin Lie and Xu Qinghe.
After seeing the body of the wolf demon on the ground, the fierce light in his eyes became even stronger.
Qin Lie subconsciously took a look with his Qi-gazing technique.
Target: Wolf Demon]
Demonic Qi: Peak of Little Demon]
After seeing this reminder, Qin Lie's heart immediately sank to the bottom.
The peak of the little demon!
This thing is not easy to deal with. Maybe Xu Qinghe and he will have to answer here today.
Yesterday, Lu Chen told him about the general realm between the demon race and the human race.
Ordinary monsters that are contaminated with monster energy can only be considered monsters at best, and are probably a little more ferocious than ordinary beasts.
Only those who have developed spiritual wisdom, can speak human language, and know how to disguise and calculate can be considered little monsters.
The early stage of the Little Demon Realm probably corresponds to the ninth level of the human race, the middle stage corresponds to the eighth level, and the later stage almost corresponds to the seventh level of the human race.
As for the peak of the Little Demon Realm, it is the realm that is about to touch the threshold of the Demon Soldier.
If you were in the human race, they would be almost the most difficult group in the seventh rank.
Qin Lie is currently in the early stage of the ninth level. Even if his physique and agility are stronger than those of the average ninth level, it does not mean that he can go head-to-head with the peak of the Little Demon Realm.
Fortunately, Xu Qinghe is still here. Judging from how calm she is now, she can probably cope with the current situation.
"The boys from the Demon Suppression Department arrived too soon."
"You are very courageous if you dare to kill my subordinates, Lang Feng."
When speaking, Langfeng showed the strong white teeth in his mouth.
But soon, his eyes fell on Xu Qinghe. After looking up and down, a disgusting smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"Kill the man and keep the woman, just in time to bring her back to the cave to make me happy."
After Qin Lie heard this, his eyes instantly turned cold.
He clenched the demon-suppressing knife in his hand and was about to take a step forward, but Xu Qinghe next to him laughed softly.
The laughter was very light, but it made Qin Lie feel a chill down his back for no reason.
Xu Qinghe slowly closed the book in his hand and looked up at the wolf demon.
"What did you just say? I didn't hear it clearly."
"How about you say it again and I'll listen."
After hearing this, Lang Feng laughed even more arrogantly.
"What can I do if I say it again?"
"I'm going to let you know what real happiness is soon!"
Hearing what Lang Feng said, Qin Lie silently took two steps back.
Lang Feng didn't notice Qin Lie's movements, but Xu Qinghe did.
She turned her head and glanced at Qin Lie.
"Why are you retreating?"
Qin Lie clenched the demon-suppressing knife in his hand with a serious expression.
"I'm afraid you might accidentally hurt me when you do something later."
